final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented letters (NFD) and strips the combining marks before calling `slugify`.

I did not edit `vendor/slugify`. Its README says vendored code is never edited by hand. Its own changelog lists 1.2.1 as the release that transliterates accented letters, so upgrading the vendored copy is the longer-term fix. The vendored copy is still 1.2.0.

Shop URLs are unchanged: `src/shop/product-url.js` still calls `slugify` directly, so product names with accents still lose those letters. I left that alone since it's outside this task, but the 1.2.1 upgrade would fix it too.

I haven't committed anything.
